cell_reconciliation.comparison: CSV vs JSON flattened with source mapping vs XLSX

known_mapping_semantics.uf: flatten replicates source mapping: unit.uf then root.uf; unit.ufSigla is not consulted
known_mapping_semantics.link_sistema_origem: flatten replicates fallback order: linkSistemaOrigem then linkProcessoEletronico
known_mapping_semantics.link_pncp: derived URL, not a direct source JSON field
known_mapping_semantics.capturado_em_utc: capture metadata timestamp, not a direct field in each source record

limitations: JSON flattened values are independently recomputed by a faithful replica of the source flatten mapping.
The reconciliation compares exported values as strings; it does not infer semantic equivalence beyond the source's flatten rules.
The source repository is accessed only through GitHub GET operations.
Mismatch detail is capped at 1000 entries; per-field counts cover all records.
